Why You’ll Love It Here
 
• Flexible time off

We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

descriptionPlain:
About Outreach
 
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.  


About The Team
 
The People & Places Team builds the systems and experiences that make Outreach a place where talent wants to stay and grow. Whether you're designing the frameworks that keep us competitive, or shaping the day-to-day moments that define our culture, your work directly shapes how it feels to build a career here.
 
The Role
 
Reporting to the Director, Total Rewards & People Operations, we're looking for a Senior Global Rewards Analyst to own compensation and equity programs across our global workforce: from market pricing and job leveling to merit, bonus, and equity administration. This role blends deep technical analysis with end-to-end program ownership, turning market data and compensation strategy into pay practices that are competitive, equitable, and compliant across every region we operate in. As Outreach continues to scale internationally, rewards decisions increasingly shape how we attract and retain talent everywhere we hire.
Success in this role means leaders and employees can trust that pay decisions are fair, well-informed, and consistent: reflected in strong retention and a rewards program that scales cleanly as Outreach grows globally, with processes that hold up to scrutiny in every market we operate in.
Location: Seattle (hybrid) or US Remote

lists.content:
• Designing and governing global rewards programs: developing, implementing, and administering compensation and equity policies, programs, and the job architecture behind them

  • Pricing the market: determining market rates for jobs, managing survey participation and benchmark vendor relationships, and maintaining our global band structure as the organization broadens into new roles and geographies

  • Running annual cycles: administering merit, promotion, bonus, and equity grant programs end to end, including eligibility, system testing, and partnering with Finance on budgeting

  • Partner to the business: evaluating new jobs, promotions, offers, and reclassifications, and partnering with Recruiting and People Business Partners in forming and delivering recommendations

  • Keeping us compliant: staying current on pay regulations, including FLSA, EEOC, pay transparency, and pay data reporting obligations

  • Turning data into insight: building analyses and reporting from HRIS, payroll, and survey data on pay equity, competitiveness, and retention, and delivering ad hoc requests for the People team, executives, and the Board

  • Communicating and educating on rewards: designing and reward communications and education that drive understanding of the value of our rewards programs within our employee and manager populations

  • Continuous improvement and innovation: moving the needle on making our reward processes and programs more efficient, using the tools at your disposal, including AI, to transform reward delivery

• 5+ years in compensation or total rewards at a high-growth company where you owned real scope rather than one slice of a large center of excellence; you're scrappy, enterprising, and comfortable without a lot of infrastructure around you

  • You've run annual merit cycles and equity refresh grants yourself, from design through communication and delivery

  • Hands-on experience evaluating and matching roles to survey data, constructing and maintaining salary ranges, and defending the methodology behind both

  • Expert-level Excel skills, with a track record of building and maintaining complex models for range analysis, cost scenarios, and cycle planning

  • Comfortable interfacing with and influencing Recruiting, People Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders up through the VP and C-suite

  • Comfort with HR tools (our stack: Workday + Lever) and an appetite for building cleaner, more automated data foundations rather than rebuilding the same file every cycle

  • Working knowledge of pay regulations and practices, and a demonstrated ability to handle highly sensitive information with care

  • Motivated to learn, take on more, and grow alongside the function

salaryDescription: The annual base salary range for this role is $140,000-$155,000. You may also be offered incentive compensation, bonus, restricted stock units, and benefits. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, location and experience. Final offers are determined through a holistic assessment and will vary within the posted range. Your Recruiter will share specific details based on your location and role during the hiring process.
